items.title: Support Agents
items.description: Frontline customer support staff handling ticket triage and customer communication across Dublin and Austin offices.

quotes.quote: 62 agents across Dublin and Austin, plus 11 escalation engineers.

items.title: Escalation Engineers
items.description: Technical specialists handling advanced customer issues and maintaining engineering runbooks.

quotes.quote: 62 agents across Dublin and Austin, plus 11 escalation engineers.

items.title: Reduce Average Handle Time
items.description: Decrease ticket handle time from 14 minutes down to under 9 minutes using AI-assisted drafting and search.

quotes.quote: Average handle time from 14 minutes to under 9, and re-routing under 5%.

items.title: Reduce Ticket Re-routing Rate
items.description: Lower the percentage of misrouted tickets from 22% to below 5% through automated classification.

quotes.quote: Average handle time from 14 minutes to under 9, and re-routing under 5%.

items.title: Ticket Volume and Concurrency Scalability
items.description: Support an annual volume of 41,000 tickets growing at 18% year-over-year with peaks of 280 tickets per day.

quotes.quote: 41,000 tickets last year, growing about 18% year on year. 62 agents across Dublin and Austin, plus 11 escalation engineers. Peak is 280 tickets a day after a release.

items.title: Confluence Cloud
items.description: Primary repository containing 2,400 pages of internal product documentation.

quotes.quote: Product documentation is 2,400 pages in Confluence Cloud and a public docs site built from Markdown in GitHub.

items.title: GitHub Public Documentation
items.description: Public documentation site source files stored as Markdown in GitHub.

quotes.quote: Product documentation is 2,400 pages in Confluence Cloud and a public docs site built from Markdown in GitHub.

items.title: Zendesk
items.description: Core ticketing system containing 96,000 historical closed tickets spanning six years.

quotes.quote: Closed tickets are in Zendesk, about 96,000 of them going back six years.

items.title: SharePoint Runbooks
items.description: Repository holding 340 engineering runbooks used for technical escalations.

quotes.quote: There are also 340 internal runbooks in SharePoint that engineering maintains.

items.title: Zendesk Integration
items.description: Bidirectional integration to ingest incoming tickets and embed the agent-assist interface within the agent ticket view.

quotes.quote: What I imagine is a panel next to the ticket in Zendesk that shows a suggested reply, the sources it used, and similar past tickets.

items.title: Confluence Cloud Ingestion
items.description: Inbound connector to index product documentation pages from Confluence Cloud.

quotes.quote: Product documentation is 2,400 pages in Confluence Cloud and a public docs site built from Markdown in GitHub.

items.title: GitHub Markdown Documentation Ingestion
items.description: Inbound connector to index public documentation files hosted in GitHub.

quotes.quote: Product documentation is 2,400 pages in Confluence Cloud and a public docs site built from Markdown in GitHub.

items.title: SharePoint Runbooks Ingestion
items.description: Inbound connector to index engineering runbooks stored in SharePoint.

quotes.quote: There are also 340 internal runbooks in SharePoint that engineering maintains.

items.title: Grounded Reply Drafting with Source Attribution
items.description: Generate suggested replies grounded in documentation and historical tickets, showing cited sources for agent review.

quotes.quote: Draft a reply for the agent, grounded in documentation and similar past tickets, with the sources shown. The agent edits and sends. Nothing goes to a customer unreviewed.

items.title: Ticket Classification and Automated Routing
items.description: Classify incoming tickets by product area and issue category (bug, how-to, billing, outage) and route to appropriate queues.

quotes.quote: Classify incoming tickets by product area and by type (bug, how-to, billing, outage) and route to the right queue.

items.title: Ticket Priority Suggestion
items.description: Provide priority recommendation options while respecting contractual SLA tiers and routing rules.

quotes.quote: Suggest a priority. Rafael thinks priority should stay a rule, not a model output, because our SLA tiers are contractual. Happy to be argued with.

items.title: Similar Past Ticket Retrieval
items.description: Retrieve and display the top three most relevant past tickets alongside their resolutions.

quotes.quote: Surface the three most similar past tickets with their resolution.

items.title: Exclusion of Customer-Facing Chatbot
items.description: Exclude all direct customer-facing conversational interfaces from the project scope for this phase.

quotes.quote: No customer-facing chatbot in this phase. We tried one in 2024 with another vendor and the deflection numbers were not real.

items.title: Vendor-Neutral Cloud Selection
items.description: Evaluate and recommend a cloud platform provider with comparative trade-off and lock-in analysis.

quotes.quote: We genuinely do not have a preference. We run on a mix today — the product is on one provider, our data tooling on another, and the contracts renew at different times. We would like your recommendation and the reasoning, and we would like to understand what we would be locked into.

items.title: Q3 2026 Production Delivery Target
items.description: Deploy an initial operational release in front of support agents by the end of Q3 2026.

quotes.quote: We would like something in front of agents by the end of Q3 2026. It does not have to do everything on day one.

items.title: Pre-Inference PII and Credential Redaction
items.description: Redact customer personal data, pasted credentials, and internal hostnames prior to model invocation with verifiable audit logs.

quotes.quote: Ticket bodies contain customer personal data and, in maybe 5% of cases, credentials and internal system names that customers paste into descriptions. Anything we send to a model must be redacted first, and we need evidence that redaction happened.

items.title: EU Data Residency and Regional Inference
items.description: Ensure inference and data persistence remain strictly within EU boundaries without cross-border prompt retention for abuse monitoring.

quotes.quote: About 30% of our customers are EU-based and three of our enterprise contracts contain an EU data-residency clause. I need to know where inference happens and where anything is retained. If a provider retains prompts for abuse monitoring outside the EU, that is a problem.

items.title: 24-Month Source Attribution Audit Retention
items.description: Retain an auditable record of model call timestamps and cited retrieval documents for 24 months for every generated draft.

quotes.quote: We need to be able to answer, for any generated draft, which documents it used and when the model was called. Retention of that record: 24 months.

items.title: Contractual Prohibition of Model Training on Customer Data
items.description: Enforce legal and contractual guarantees preventing third-party model providers from training on customer data.

quotes.quote: No training on our customer data by any third party. This needs to be contractual, not a setting someone can toggle.

items.title: Error Handling and Quality Governance Process
items.description: Establish a documented operating procedure and error detection mechanism for handling inaccurate agent-sent responses.

quotes.quote: I want a documented process for what happens when the assistant produces something wrong and an agent sends it. Who is accountable, and how do we detect it.

items.title: Zendesk Sidebar Agent Panel
items.description: Provide a side-panel interface embedded directly in Zendesk to present drafts, source citations, and similar tickets to agents.

quotes.quote: What I imagine is a panel next to the ticket in Zendesk that shows a suggested reply, the sources it used, and similar past tickets. The agent stays in control.

items.title: Bi-Weekly Knowledge Synchronization
items.description: Update knowledge indexes on a bi-weekly cadence aligning with product release cycles to prevent referencing obsolete information.

quotes.quote: Documentation changes with every two-week release, so whatever indexes it has to keep up. We have had situations where an agent quoted a page that was superseded.

items.title: Outdated Ticket Deprecation Handling
items.description: Filter or down-weight outdated guidance and deprecated procedures present in historical ticket archives.

quotes.quote: Our older tickets contain advice that is now wrong. I do not know how you handle that.

items.title: Cross-Product Terminology Disambiguation
items.description: Support disambiguation of overlapping technical terms across the four distinct product lines.

quotes.quote: We have four products and the terminology overlaps. "Schedule" means something different in two of them.

items.title: Defensible Accuracy and Evaluation Framework
items.description: Implement a rigorous and measurable offline/online evaluation framework for answer quality and generation accuracy.

quotes.quote: Somebody will ask about accuracy and I will need a defensible answer, not a demo.

items.title: Internal Team Skillset and Delivery Capacity
items.description: Design solution maintainability for a 9-person platform team with zero in-house machine learning engineering staff.

quotes.quote: We have no in-house machine-learning people. We have a strong platform team of nine.
